title: Affine tensor computation on specified module representatives
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and A=Gamma(X,O_X). Let M,N,P be unbounded A-module complexes, s:P→M a quasi-isomorphism, and P categorically K-flat [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Let C be termwise tilde followed by termwise exact restriction along X.toSpecΓ. In the derived tensor structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], Q(C(M)) tensor-derived Q(C(N)) is isomorphic to Q(C(Tot(P tensor_A N))). No cohomological quasi-coherence hypothesis occurs.

source.place: Lemma 36.3.9, proof of (1), locality and the K-flat computation (2); Tag 08DV for tilde K-flatness

proof.text: Import the existing private tilde_preservesKernel theorem from AffineDerivedTildeHomologyComparison using a proof-only import all. This supplies kernel preservation without duplicating its proof. Together with tilde additivity and its left adjoint structure it gives finite-limit preservation. Exact open restriction therefore sends the given quasi-isomorphism s to a quasi-isomorphism.

Use kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic to convert the categorical module K-flat hypothesis into the acyclicity criterion for right tensor. Apply isKFlat_tilde and then isKFlat_restrict to obtain a K-flat first representative on X.

Apply the natural K-flat derived tensor comparison to constant singleton families of the two chart complexes and take its component. The underived chart total-tensor isomorphism, mapped by Q, identifies its output with Q of the chart image of Tot(P tensor N). Finally tensor the inverse of Q applied to the restricted tilde quasi-isomorphism s with the identity of the second derived input, and compose the three isomorphisms.
